documents.title: Summary of Opinions at the Monetary Policy Meeting - December 2025
documents.description: Bank of Japan's summary of opinions from the Monetary Policy Meeting held December 18-19, 2025. Discusses policy interest rate adjustments, economic developments, price trends, wage dynamics, and monetary accommodation. Includes views on raising policy rates and adjusting monetary accommodation to achieve price stability target.

documents.title: Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices - October 2025
documents.description: Bank of Japan's comprehensive outlook report on economic activity and prices. Discusses Japan's economic growth trajectory, CPI inflation trends, monetary policy outlook, labor market conditions, wage dynamics, and risks to the economic outlook. Includes detailed analysis of wage-price pass-through mechanisms.

documents.title: Outlook for the Economy and Monetary Policy - Michelle W. Bowman
documents.description: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Michelle W. Bowman's speech on economic outlook, monetary policy path, labor market fragility, and inflation trajectory. Discusses recent policy decisions, evolution of economic views, and supervisory priorities.

documents.title: Statement on DOJ Subpoenas - Jerome H. Powell
documents.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell's statement addressing DOJ grand jury subpoenas and threats of criminal indictment. Addresses concerns about Fed independence, political pressure on monetary policy, and commitment to evidence-based interest rate decisions.

documents.title: Monetary Policy Report - November 2025
documents.description: Bank of England's quarterly Monetary Policy Report from November 2025. The Monetary Policy Committee voted 5-4 to maintain Bank Rate at 4%. The report discusses inflation trends (CPI at 3.8% in September), underlying wage and price pressures, economic activity, labor market conditions, and the outlook for monetary policy. Includes analysis of risks around inflation persistence and weaker demand, with projections for inflation returning towards the 2% target.

documents.title: Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices - January 2026
documents.description: Bank of Japan's quarterly Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices report from January 2026. The Policy Board projects Japan's economy to continue growing moderately, with CPI inflation likely to decelerate below 2% in the first half of 2026 before gradually rising to levels consistent with the price stability target. Includes GDP growth projections for fiscal 2025-2027, analysis of wage-price dynamics, monetary policy outlook with expectations for continued policy rate increases, and assessment of risks including trade policies, overseas economic activity, and financial market developments.

documents.title: Monetary Policy Meeting Minutes - January 28, 2026
documents.description: Bank of Japan's Monetary Policy Meeting minutes from January 28, 2026. Contains detailed discussions and decisions from the Policy Board meeting, including policy rate decisions, assessment of economic and financial conditions, price developments, and the outlook for economic activity and prices. Provides insights into the Board's views on monetary policy stance and future policy direction.

documents.title: FOMC Statement - January 28, 2026
documents.description: Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statement from January 28, 2026. Contains the Committee's decision on the target range for the federal funds rate, assessment of economic activity, labor market conditions, inflation developments, and the outlook for monetary policy. Provides key insights into the Fed's policy stance and forward guidance on interest rates.
